# Security camera bid calculator

> Price an IP security camera install from the drops, the cable, and the labour — and check the three things a camera bid gets wrong: days of recording the drives actually hold, PoE load against the switch budget, and runs past the 328 ft Ethernet limit.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
